text:
priya: Heads up — EdgeGate (hardware marketplace) wants SOC2 summary + pen-test artifacts and a short attestation for listing. They asked for an "owner+handoff" plan. Can someone take point on ingest and redaction?

maria: I can own ingest + presign flow. timeline?

priya: TY. initial bundle by EOW, final redacted artifacts next Wed. Legal wants PII removed and a signed attestation PDF.

zack: Quick Q — do they need raw reports or redacted copies? The SI said: 'full reports with sensitive customer PII redacted, but system-level logs can stay'.

leo: For pen reports we should keep a golden copy in the SOC bucket and provide presigned redacted artifacts to partner. I'll handle golden copy retention policy.

maria: Plan: 1) collect reports to s3://redwood-partner-ingest/edgegate/1717778888/raw 2) run redaction tool -> s3://redwood-partner-ingest/edgegate/1717778888/redacted 3) generate attestation + presign links for 7d. Anyone ok with that?

priya: Sounds good. @zack can you confirm redaction checklist (IPs, customer emails, API keys, internal hostnames)? Legal added TLS cert serials to the list.

zack: Confirmed. Redaction checklist: IPs, emails, usernames, API keys, session tokens, full stack traces with user identifiers, internal hostnames, cert serials. Keep system metrics/versions.

maria: Example presign command I'll use (to automate):
```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-partner-ingest/edgegate/1717778888/redacted/edgegate-soc2-redacted.pdf --expires-in 604800
```

si-integration: FYI — EdgeGate's listing process requires a metadata JSON alongside artifacts with fields: partner_id, artifact_type, scan_date, redacted_by, contact_email. I'll attach the schema in the partner portal.

priya: Good call. Add contact_email = partnerships@redwood.ai and redacted_by field equals the SRE engineer who ran the tool.

security-bot: Vulnerability-scan job scheduled: 2024-05-01T09:00:00Z for edgegate-integration. Ticket #VG-4821.

leo: Owner matrix: partnerships->priya (coord + attestation), ingest->maria, redaction->zack, retention->leo, SI comms->si-integration. I'll create the tracking doc and share.

maria: One ask — does EdgeGate want a tenant-isolated artifact bundle (per-region)? If yes, we'll need presigned locations per region.

priya: They asked for single bundle first; if they request region split we'll handle as follow-up. For now keep everything in the partnership bucket and mark region=global in metadata.

zack: ETA: I'll run redaction scripts tomorrow morning and drop first-pass artifacts by 1717779500.

priya: Awesome. I'll draft the attestation text and loop in legal for a quick sign-off. Thanks all :thumbsup:
